overview_description.description: Gulf Navigation Holding is a shipping company involved in marine transportation of commodities and chartering vessels. Gulf Navigation Holding PJSC (GNH) is a fully integrated and synergized organization and a one-stop shop with a multi-functional business providing high quality services through its subsidiaries. It is the only shipping company listed in the Dubai Financial Market (DFM) since February 2007 under the symbol “GULFNAV”.

product.name: Marine Transportation of Commodities
product.description: Provides shipping services for transporting petrochemical and other commodities using a fleet of tankers and support vessels.

product.name: Chartering Vessels
product.description: Offers vessel chartering services including chemical tankers, livestock transport, and offshore support vessels to clients in the maritime and energy sectors.

product.name: Marine Agency Services
product.description: Delivers agency services supporting maritime operations including vessel coordination, regulatory compliance, and port services.

product.name: Ship Repair Operations
product.description: Provides maintenance and repair services for vessels to ensure compliance with maritime safety and environmental standards.
